## TrailFold — first-time Daypack post-purchase flow

**Launch status: draft.** This is a three-email marketing flow for first-time purchasers of `DAY18` only. It is designed around confirmed delivery, not estimated delivery, so no customer is asked to review or shop accessories before the bag has arrived.

### Entry and guardrails
- **Entry event:** Order Placed where line item SKU = `DAY18`.
- **First-time rule:** zero prior qualifying TrailFold orders before the entry order. Configure against the order-history field available in the CRM; do not rely on a manually maintained profile tag.
- **Marketing eligibility:** send only to profiles with valid email marketing consent. Transactional order/shipping messages remain outside this flow.
- **Delivery gate:** wait for carrier/Shopify **Delivered** status matching the qualifying order. If a reliable delivered event and order identifier cannot be verified, do not activate this flow; do not substitute the 4–7-business-day estimate for delivery confirmation.
- **Global suppression:** immediately exit and suppress all remaining flow emails if the qualifying order is cancelled, refunded, or has a return initiated/created. Also exit if the customer places another order after entry; this avoids presenting accessories to someone who may already have purchased them.
- **Accessory suppression:** suppress Email 3 if the customer has purchased `POUCH` or `BOTTLE` at any point before that send.

### Flow logic
1. After confirmed delivery, wait **1 day** and send onboarding.
2. Wait until **10 days after confirmed delivery** and send the review request.
3. Wait until **21 days after confirmed delivery** and send the optional accessory email.

No discount is included or implied. The accessory message is intentionally low-pressure because the Daypack is a durable good rather than a replenishment product.

### Measurement
Randomly assign **10%** of otherwise eligible entrants to a persistent `day18_post_purchase_holdout = true` property at flow entry. Holdout profiles receive none of these three flow messages for 45 days after delivery, but continue to receive required transactional communications. Compare **60-day second-order rate** from qualifying-order date between treatment and holdout. Report eligible profiles, delivered-event rate, sends, clicks, unsubscribes, refunds/returns, and treatment-versus-holdout second-order rate; treat this as a directional flow measurement, not proof of incremental lift if other marketing exposure differs.

### CRM implementation notes
Use order ID as the flow key where possible so a later order does not accidentally release a suppressed message. Re-check refund, cancellation, return, subsequent-order, accessory-purchase, and consent conditions immediately before every send—not only at entry. Add UTM parameters to product and review links. Review the final return-policy language against the live policy page before activation.

emails.name: Useful onboarding
emails.subject: Your Daypack 18L is here—start with these basics
emails.preheader: A few practical details for your commute and short trips.
emails.body:
Hi {{ first_name|default:'there' }},

Your Daypack 18L should now be in hand.

A few useful starting points:
• The padded laptop sleeve is sized for a 13-inch laptop.
• Use the external pocket for a water bottle or quick-grab item.
• The fabric is water-resistant, not waterproof—keep electronics protected in sustained rain.

For travel planning, US delivery is generally estimated at 4–7 business days from order placement. If something is not right with your order, reply to this email and our team can help.

Need to make a return? Unused products can be returned within 30 days. Return shipping is paid by the customer.

[View the Daypack 18L]({{ daypack_product_url }}?utm_source=klaviyo&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day18_postpurchase_onboarding)

— TrailFold

emails.name: Review request
emails.subject: How is the Daypack 18L working for you?
emails.preheader: An honest review helps other commuters choose clearly.
emails.body:
Hi {{ first_name|default:'there' }},

You have had some time with your Daypack 18L. If you can spare a minute, we would appreciate an honest review.

The most useful details for other shoppers are how you use it day to day, what you carry, and whether the laptop sleeve works for your setup. Please share only what you experienced.

[Write a review]({{ daypack_review_url }}?utm_source=klaviyo&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day18_postpurchase_review)

If the Daypack is not right for you, unused products can be returned within 30 days; return shipping is paid by the customer.

— TrailFold

emails.name: Optional accessory cross-sell
emails.subject: A simple add-on for your Daypack setup
emails.preheader: Optional organizers for cables and everyday carry.
emails.body:
Hi {{ first_name|default:'there' }},

If you are settling into a Daypack routine, two optional additions may be useful:

• Cable pouch — $20 for keeping small tech items together.
• Steel bottle — $32 for daily carry.

No bundle, deadline, or discount—just useful options if they fit your setup.

[See accessories]({{ accessories_collection_url }}?utm_source=klaviyo&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day18_postpurchase_accessories)

— TrailFold

actions.holdout_rule: Randomly assign at flow entry; persist property day18_post_purchase_holdout=true; suppress all three flow emails for 45 days after confirmed delivery.

primary_metric.name: 60-day second-order rate
primary_metric.definition: Percentage of eligible qualifying Daypack purchasers placing any subsequent order within 60 days of the qualifying order date; compare treatment versus randomized holdout.
primary_metric.reporting_note: Also report eligible entrants, delivered-event coverage, send rate, click rate, unsubscribe rate, refund/return rate, and absolute treatment-control difference.

questions: Is a carrier or Shopify Delivered event available in Klaviyo with an order ID that can be matched to the DAY18 order?
What is the approved review destination URL and review-provider event/field structure?
Which exact order, refund, cancellation, and return event names and line-item fields are available for pre-send suppression checks?

brand.positioning: Practical lightweight bags for commuters who take short weekend trips; restrained, useful, plain-spoken voice.

policies.shipping: Free US shipping; delivery estimate 4-7 business days
policies.returns: 30-day returns for unused products; return shipping paid by customer
policies.discounts: No current discount. Any new discount needs owner approval.

claim_constraints: No evidence for waterproof, medical, sustainability or lifetime-durability claims.
No clinical or controlled product test results.

themes: customers ask whether a 15-inch laptop fits
customers ask whether rain protection means waterproof
customer_themes.note: Themes, not verbatim licensed testimonials; no fabricated quotes or endorsements.

website_snapshot.pdp_details: Laptop sizing and delivery window are below reviews; CTA says Buy now. No field speed or session-recording data.

shopify.definitions: Revenue excludes tax/shipping; periods equal length. Funnel counts are session-based and internally consistent, but no controlled attribution experiment.

meta.settings: 7-day click plus 1-day view; no incremental lift study. Meta reported value not reconciled to Shopify orders.

creative_history.name: Desk-to-trail demonstration
creative_history.observed_result: Largest spend recipient; mature creative. No asset-level contribution data.

creative_history.name: Laptop-fit comparison
creative_history.observed_result: Higher CTR in small test; conversion sample not supplied.

flows.name: checkout abandonment
flows.observed_gap: No Added to Cart flow; filters not audited.

klaviyo.note: Revenue attribution overlaps other systems; no holdout or recent deliverability audit.

resources.cash_constraint: Protect replenishment payments; no additional inventory purchase approved.

task.title: Post-purchase retention flow
task.request: Create a practical post-purchase email flow for first-time Daypack buyers with three actual emails: useful onboarding, review request and optional accessory cross-sell. Include event/timing, eligibility, suppression, returns/refunds, delivery uncertainty and a small holdout measurement. Bags are durable goods, not replenishable subscriptions. Do not request a review before confirmed delivery or imply known repeat-purchase lift. Return actions.emails with subject/body/timing and actions.primary_metric. Make it ready for an agency CRM specialist to configure after verifying event fields.
